name: HSRP Lab 2 - Load Sharing & Uplink Tracking

notes.text: HSRP Lab 2 - Load Sharing + Tracking: VLAN10 Active DSW1 (110), VLAN20 Active DSW2 (110). R1 = ISP, Lo0 8.8.8.8. Each core: track 1 interface g0/1 line-protocol + standby X track 1 decrement 20. Test: R1 int g0/0 shutdown -> DSW1 track Down, pri 110->90, DSW2 takes VLAN10, PC1 still pings 8.8.8.8. no shut -> DSW1 preempts back.
